The '''Onderon repeating carbine''' was a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] that had been employed by the elite troops of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] most probably during the [[Second battle of Onderon (Mandalorian Wars)|Second Battle of Onderon]] in the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Although it was unclear at which battle these weapons predominated, it was believed that the power of these carbines, combined with their high rate of fire played a considerable role in the rout of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces. This would lend support for these carbines to have been used during the liberation of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] from the Mandalorians.
